description:
## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

solidity_test calls the shared helper. forge uses the Nix solc offline (the existing solc bug), and HOME is pinned, so ~/.foundry and svm under $HOME are never read (spec §4).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An unchanged solidity_test is a hit on the second run
- [ ] forge never reads or downloads anything under the user's home

## Blocked by

- turnkey-vnm.5
- turnkey-vnm.22
- turnkey-vnm.23
- turnkey-gu7

comments.text: From turnkey-vnm.22: solidity_test also has a fork_url attribute that makes forge read chain state over the network. That is a rule-level wrong-hit hazard not in the research. A target with fork_url set must not be cached: have the rule treat fork_url as no-test-cache (don't call the caching helper for it).

title: Solidity tests are cached
